recognize_zh: 抹片中的淋巴球核圓或卵圓、染色質均勻，細胞質豐富淡藍並有毛狀突起；切片呈「荷包蛋」樣間隔排列，TRAP、CD123、cyclin D1、Annexin A1 陽性但 BRAF 陰性，流式 CD25+/CD11c+ 而 CD103 陰性，仍符合毛細胞白血病。
features: Smear (A): medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections
H&E (B): diffuse infiltrate of evenly spaced cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and clear to pale cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
IHC: strong CD20 (C), TRAP (D), CD123 (E), weak nuclear cyclin D1 (F) and Annexin A1 (L) positive; BRAF V600E (G) negative
Flow: absent monocyte cluster on CD45/SSC (H); CD19+ CD25+ (I); CD11c+ with CD103 negative (J); kappa light chain restriction (K)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections. The core biopsy shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of evenly spaced cells with bean-shaped nuclei and pale cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry, the cells are positive for CD20, TRAP, CD123, cyclin D1 (weak), and annexin A1, but negative for BRAF V600E. Flow cytometry shows monocytopenia and a kappa-restricted B-cell population expressing CD19, CD25, and CD11c without CD103. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with an unusual BRAF-negative, CD103-negative phenotype.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v has prominent nucleoli, lacks CD25, annexin A1, TRAP and CD123, and has no monocytopenia, whereas these cells are CD25+ and annexin A1+.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have villous cytoplasm but are CD25-, CD123-, annexin A1-negative with intrasinusoidal marrow pattern.
SMZL cells show polar short villi, nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow involvement, and are negative for annexin A1, CD103, and usually CD25/CD123.
Mantle cell lymphoma shows strong cyclin D1 with CD5 expression and lacks TRAP, CD25, CD11c and annexin A1 together with hairy cytoplasm.

stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E; IHC panel; flow cytometry
